notes: Relative project roots resolve relative to the catalog file location.
The default catalog file is local and gitignored; the example uses a relative root and contains no machine-specific absolute path.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Projects are discovered under process.cwd()/projects, with process.cwd()/project.json as a legacy root.
assumptions.replacement: Load enabled projects from the workspace catalog, then use project path helpers for manifests/scenes; retain embedded roots only as documented legacy fallback.
Resolve scene JSON through projectPaths.sceneFile(<id>) so catalog projects use Assets/Scenes and legacy projects use scenes.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Asset registry is process.cwd()/public/assets/registry.json and scene usage reads <projectRoot>/scenes.
assumptions.replacement: Read/write ProjectSettings/registries/assets.json through project paths and collect usage from project-local scenes.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Uploads write media files under process.cwd()/public/assets/<type> and mutate app-local assets registry.
assumptions.replacement: Require/resolve project id, write to Assets/Media/<type>, and mutate project-local asset registry.
List files under Assets/Media/<type> for the selected project.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Container swaps mutate process.cwd()/public/assets/registry.json and require /assets/<type>/ paths.
assumptions.replacement: Mutate selected project registry and validate logical file paths against /projects/<id>/assets/<type>/ or exported /assets/<type>/ forms.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Fonts are discovered from app-local public/fonts and public/assets/font.
assumptions.replacement: Discover fonts from Assets/Fonts and project-local media font folders through project paths.
Load project-aware registry URLs based on MELEE_PROJECT_ID in dev while preserving bundle-relative export URLs.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Export reads registries/assets/modules/fonts from app-local public and scenes from selected project root.
assumptions.replacement: Export scenes, project-local registries, media, modules, and fonts from the selected catalog project via path helpers, emitting the current static bundle shape.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Module manifest lookup and scene reads assume appRoot/public and <projectDir>/scenes.
assumptions.replacement: Resolve manifests and scene files through project paths and preserve logical web paths for static bundle rewriting.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Desktop runtime preparation may seed/copy app-local public/projects content.
assumptions.replacement: Seed only engine runtime assets plus a local catalog/example; do not treat Codecaine project content as engine-owned.

assumptions.currentAssumption: Docs describe projects/<id>, public/assets, public/modules, public/fonts as source locations.
assumptions.replacement: Document workspace catalog, external project layout, project-local registries, and legacy fallback boundaries.
